authorization: User approved applying Stanford-only calibration to the mixed model and repeating the unseen normal test.
question: Can the mixed model keep high scores for unseen normal gait while recovering Stanford high-GDI error, if only the final calibration is fitted on Stanford training rows?

arms.mixed: Mixed trained models, calibration fitted on Stanford + LJMU training rows.
arms.mixed_stanford_cal: Same mixed networks, selected epochs and bag members. Each member slope and intercept refitted by least squares on that member's Stanford training rows only.

fusion: Fixed fold weights from bundle/ensemble.json in every arm, including the bilateral refit term. No weight search.
calibration_data: Each member's train_raw from replay.npz, restricted to Stanford rows. Held-out people are never used.
stanford_evaluation: Held-out raw outputs in replay.npz, 692 people, equal person weight. Thresholds apply to the actual record-side GDI. Same rule as compare_high_gdi.py.
external_sets: live, self, ljmu_original from the parent study inputs. Perturbation sets are not rerun.

preregistered_criteria.C1_stanford_high_recovery: Stanford actual GDI >= 90 MAE: paired 95% upper bound of (mixed_stanford_cal minus baseline) <= +0.5 points. Margin chosen before results.
preregistered_criteria.C2_external_kept: Live person mean >= 90 and self normal video mean >= 90 under mixed_stanford_cal.
preregistered_criteria.C3_discrimination_kept: Self normal minus abnormal gap >= 12.67 and video score ranges do not overlap under mixed_stanford_cal.
preregistered_criteria.overall: C1 and C2 and C3 all pass: both effects can coexist on this development comparison. Otherwise report which failed.
preregistered_criteria.reported_without_threshold: Stanford overall MAE, GDI >= 100 MAE, GDI < 70 MAE, prediction slope, LJMU mean.

uncertainty: Paired person bootstrap, 10000 draws, seed 20261105. Exploratory, not adjusted for multiple comparisons, conditional on fitted models.

validation.checkpoint_hashes: Every checkpoint SHA-256 must match complete.json.
validation.replay_external: Member outputs with stored mixed calibration must reproduce parent results for live, self and ljmu_original.
validation.replay_stanford: Member held-out raw outputs with stored mixed calibration must reproduce comparison-predictions.npz mixed fusion on Stanford rows.
validation.ols: Stanford-only coefficients must match an independent closed-form slope and intercept.

limitations: The parent study already showed this calibration direction helped CNN and STT, so C1 is a confirmation on the same development data, not an independent test.
Live and self were already seen in the parent study.
No measured GDI exists for the external sets.
Calibration only rescales outputs; it cannot change a network's ranking within one member.
